verdict.rationale: Cline Kanban runs multiple coding agents in parallel, each card in its own isolated git worktree, and lets you review each card's diff. That covers parallel execution and per-run review. However, the docs frame cards as separate tasks with dependency chains, not as competing attempts at the same task, and they describe no side-by-side comparison or pick-a-winner flow. Subagents are research helpers that report back to the main agent, so they don't count as alternative task attempts. Missing for 10: documented multiple attempts of the same task, side-by-side comparison of results, a choose-and-merge-one-attempt workflow, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one

citations.quote: Use Cline Kanban to run multiple coding agents in parallel with isolated git worktrees.
Run many agents in parallel from a web-based task board with per-card worktrees, auto-commit, and dependency chains.
Review diffs in card detail view and leave inline comments.
